rationale: Committee session/document feed is a distinct continuously-producing stream on zakoni.skupstina.me, not covered by the parliament front page.
Parliament portal is the parent scheduling layer; durable standalone hub for plenary agendas and adoption notices.
Tagged MoF consultation feed is the earliest structured signal of banking/payments drafts; verification failure is likely query-string related, not fatal.
Proponent-ministry portal and document library publishing nacrti and izvjestaji sa javne rasprave; distinct from the news feed.
Central government document repository holding the primary draft/bill PDFs; a durable retrieval endpoint.
Cabinet session communiques mark the decisive utvrdjivanje step; recurring, high-credibility signal stream.
Official Gazette is the publisher of record fixing entry-into-force dates; indispensable for A3 deadline accuracy.
Commercial consolidator with unclear licence terms and failed verification; useful cross-check but reachability and legality need a second look.
Ministry of European Affairs owns the tabele usklađenosti that map national articles to CRD/CRR/PSD/AMLD; standalone EU-alignment stream.
Single dated PPCG PDF — high-value deadline evidence, but a one-off artifact superseded annually rather than a live feed.
EU integration portal is the parent hub publishing successive PPCG editions and chapter status; worth monitoring for the next programme.
Cross-ministry e-participation consultation index catches drafts a single ministry feed misses; failed check is soft, re-verify liveness.
Static procedural rulebooks — schema reference for pipeline stage prediction, not a recurring signal source.
Single statute PDF on an unrelated municipal host; useful vacatio legis reference only, re-source from the gazette if possible.
Parliamentary budget office publishes recurring independent fiscal analyses; separate output stream from the committee pages.
Specialist Montenegrin banking trade press giving early operational framing of pending payments legislation; monitor as secondary signal.
General economy press section as bill-stage early warning; lower credibility so treat as discovery, never as authority.
Professional-services insights hub gives timely English summaries of Montenegrin drafts; recurring publication, secondary to official texts.
Single NGO campaign page on transparency of tabele usklađenosti; calibration evidence rather than a monitored feed, and reuse terms unclear.
International legal index with partial, lagged financial-sector coverage; mine once as a fallback pointer, verification failed.
NBS banking regulation portal is a leading regional indicator and a required approval path for Serbian bidders in Montenegro; in scope as adjacent supervisor.
HNB regulation pages are the closest euro-area transposition template Montenegro follows; durable supervisory source.
FBA publishes a rare 'regulations in preparation' pre-consultation window relevant to groups also present in Montenegro; re-check liveness.
Second BiH entity supervisor; comparator regulation set with modest incremental value over FBA.
BiH central bank covering regional payment-infrastructure and SEPA alignment; in scope but indirect for Montenegrin deadlines.
Parent-group investor news carries SREP/MREL and M&A decisions binding NLB Banka Podgorica ahead of any CBCG notice.
Statutory disclosure venue giving the earliest authoritative timestamp for NLB group inside information; monitor filings for the issuer.
